name: gun_reach
title: Gun reach (docs/design/combat-ai.md §16): one gunman at a time against the player standing still in god mode (tgm in the first session) where Violet's dogs roam near Goodsprings, as in melee_spacing; an NCR trooper spawned and then moved by its offset (world axes: north of the player) beyond its weapon's reach, all items taken, given one weapon and its ammunition, set on the player. Every game loop, the fight field set: the distance at which it first attacks (GetAnimAction 2 or 3) against its weapon's max range (flamer 650, its flame 640; hunting shotgun 600; sniper rifle 3548; missile launcher 1536, blast 1000), and the distance it stops at. First run 2026-10-18: PlaceAtMe's distance alone put the shotgun, sniper and missile troopers 300-460 units away; the player was moved to the dog after the flamer trooper spawned (do runs after place), so a first session now only arrives

sessions.name: arrive
sessions.note: the player is put where a dog stands (on the navmesh, as melee_spacing) before anyone is spawned

sessions.name: flamer_far
